sla_policy: Commercial response SLA is UNKNOWN until Warmbly #55 measures a representative baseline. Issue #331 authorizes a distinct Radar delivery clock: 3 business days from a valid persisted parameter submission, never from payment confirmation.

first_canary.question: Qual e o valor tipico dos contratos publicos de pavimentacao?
first_canary.secondary_cta: Peca uma segunda leitura de contrato

opt_in_issue_90.rule: ainda_nao_pronto may offer citation or download only. No digest, newsletter or opt-in until #90 is authorized.

agenda.reason: no public booking route with owner and measured latency

reopen_gate.rule: agenda.exists may change to true only in the same PR as the authorized operational owner, a canonical CONFENGE route with local implementation and CONFENGE_WEB attribution, and a local SHA-256-bound snapshot of an immutable Warmbly #55 baseline. The baseline must census every eligible cycle over at least 28 days, contain at least 20 closed cycles, and be no more than 30 days old at activation. activation_base_sha preserves and CI verifies the atomic PR boundary. SLA remains UNKNOWN; baseline is not a promised prazo.

routes.eligibility: Public Market Answer or Contract Analysis is visible. Visitor wants method, sample, limits or evidence. No commercial urgency claimed.
routes.promised_outcome: Explorar evidencia, metodo, cobertura e limitacoes da resposta publica. Nao e diagnostico da empresa do visitante.
routes.privacy_consent: Nenhum dado pessoal. Nenhum opt-in. Resposta permanece publica sem lead gate.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the CTA hides the answer, invents coverage, or converts a learning intent into a coercive form.

routes.eligibility: A public contract or analysis is in context (Market Answer drill-down or #83 page). Visitor wants technical reading, not a company X-Ray.
routes.promised_outcome: Analise tecnica editorial ou segunda leitura humana do contrato em contexto. Fatos, inferencias e UNKNOWN permanecem separados.
routes.privacy_consent: Public contract id only to open the analysis. Name, contact and consent only if the visitor asks for a human second reading.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the route treats a public analysis as a customer case, or requires a lead to read published facts.

routes.eligibility: Market Answer canary is on screen. Visitor wants to see the informed CNPJ in that market. extra-cli Goal 03 payload or labeled fixture.
routes.promised_outcome: B2G X-Ray factual: carteira publica observada, orgaos, UFs, contratos e limites. Sem score de risco, dor ou irregularidade. Sem diagnostico automatico.
routes.privacy_consent: CNPJ is asked only to locate public-contract observations. Why and what-will-be-shown are on the field. CNPJ is not placed in URL, analytics or unnecessary logs. Name, contact and consent are not asked at this step.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if X-Ray emits risk/credit/pain scores, hides the Market Answer, invents SLA, or gates the public answer behind a lead.

routes.eligibility: Visitor wants a human review of their own contract or a second reading after X-Ray/Analysis. Document is required only when this route is chosen.
routes.promised_outcome: Defesa de Margem / Analise Meu Contrato: persist-first hand-raise for a human technical reading. No automatic legal conclusion.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent required. Purpose: retorno comercial e leitura tecnica solicitada. No nurture, no newsletter, no auto-send.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the route auto-messages, invents prazo, or treats an incomplete X-Ray as a discovered problem.

routes.eligibility: Visitor states a live operational pressure AND an owned channel exists (WhatsApp/phone catalog). Agenda is not offered because no booking route exists.
routes.promised_outcome: Falar com especialista pela rota operacional existente (WhatsApp ou ligacao). Sem prazo prometido. Sem agenda publica.
routes.privacy_consent: Clicking WhatsApp is a visitor-initiated channel. A persist-first hand-raise is used only if they also submit name/contact/consent. No auto-send.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the route offers agenda, invented SLA, or a channel without an owner.

routes.eligibility: Visitor wants to leave with the answer, citation or download. #90 Market Signals Brief is not authorized.
routes.promised_outcome: Citation text and/or download of the public answer. No form. No opt-in. No digest.
routes.privacy_consent: No personal data. Opt-in blocked until issue #90 is authorized.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if this route captures email, starts nurture, or pretends #90 is live.

routes.eligibility: Visitor has a live addition, suppression or extra-service decision and asks for human framing.
routes.promised_outcome: Persisted request for human framing of the additive context; no automatic legal conclusion.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent for commercial return about this request. No nurture, newsletter or autonomous message.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if no contract context, consent or human owner exists, or if the route implies automatic entitlement.

routes.eligibility: Visitor has a live measurement, rejection or withholding context and asks for a human reading.
routes.promised_outcome: Persisted request for human review of the measurement and available records.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent for return about the stated measurement context; no nurture or auto-send.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the route promises recovery, requests unnecessary PII or has no human owner.

routes.eligibility: Visitor has a contract event and documentary basis to distinguish reajuste, repactuacao or reequilibrio.
routes.promised_outcome: Persisted request for human framing of the economic-financial context.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent for return about this request; no newsletter or autonomous protocol.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the route computes or promises a right without documents and human review.

routes.eligibility: Visitor has an edital or proposal budget and asks for a scoped human audit.
routes.promised_outcome: Persisted request to frame the budget, reference base and pending decision.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent for return about the budget request; no nurture or auto-send.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if no edital/budget context exists or if the route invents price, SLA or approval.

routes.eligibility: Visitor has a live edital and needs a human go/no-go or scope decision.
routes.promised_outcome: Persisted request for triage of edital, deadline and known gaps.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent for return about this edital; no automatic submission or nurture.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the route implies proposal submission, victory or unmeasured response time.

routes.eligibility: Visitor has a live delay, critical deadline or extension context and available records.
routes.promised_outcome: Persisted request for human framing of cause, responsibility and evidence gaps.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent for return about the delay context; no auto-send or invented urgency promise.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the route assigns fault automatically or has no consent and human review.

routes.eligibility: Visitor has a notification, sanction risk or termination context and asks for technical support.
routes.promised_outcome: Persisted request for human technical framing; formal legal representation remains outside the route.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent for return about this notification; no nurture or autonomous defense filing.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the route claims legal representation, success or automated defense.

routes.eligibility: Visitor has an active contract and needs a recurring record and decision routine.
routes.promised_outcome: Persisted request to evaluate scope and capacity for contract follow-up.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent for return about this contract routine; no auto-send or CRM behavior in web-cfg.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if capacity is not evaluated or the route promises unlimited operational coverage.

routes.eligibility: Visitor asks for the recurring offer and capacity must be confirmed before any charge.
routes.promised_outcome: Persisted capacity handraise for the catalog offer; this is not checkout.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent for offer framing only; no autonomous charge, booking, nurture or message.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if capacity is not evaluated before charge, catalog ids drift, or any message is sent autonomously.

routes.eligibility: Visitor has one live proposal, deadline and documents for a capacity check.
routes.promised_outcome: Persisted request to evaluate Bid Room scope and delivery capacity.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent for return about this proposal; no submission, charge or autonomous message.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the deadline is not feasible, capacity is unknown or the route promises victory.

routes.eligibility: Visitor asks for the versioned one-off paid diagnosis and provides enough context for acceptance review.
routes.promised_outcome: Persisted request for human acceptance of CFG-DIAG-EXP-v1; no charge or checkout.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent for offer framing only; no newsletter, nurture, autonomous charge or message.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if catalog offer/terms drift, acceptance is skipped or any price/SLA is invented.

routes.eligibility: Visitor asks for one adapted report after reading the public synthetic model and can provide the company CNPJ, operating cut, segments, technical experience and delivery email. CONFENGE sources open tenders in that cut; opportunity count follows published availability and analysis depth is the maximum supported by company-provided information.
routes.promised_outcome: Persisted parameter order with a server-issued cfg:{offer_id}:{correlation_id} reference before the owner-operated payment handoff. CONFENGE then sources the available open tenders and prepares one adapted report within 3 business days from the valid persisted submission. Direct checkout remains disabled and this is not an approved catalog SKU.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent covers use of the submitted company, scope and contact data to produce and deliver this Radar order. Analytics receive only normalized non-PII dimensions; no CNPJ, contact, acervo text or autonomous message leaves the lead contract.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if payment instructions open without a persisted server reference, if the visitor is told to supply opportunities, if opportunity count is fixed or negotiated instead of following published availability, if maximum analysis depth is negotiated or artificially capped instead of following company-provided information, if the visible unit price differs from BRL 599, if the delivery clock starts at payment, if direct checkout is enabled, or if analytics receive CNPJ, contact or acervo text.

routes.eligibility: Visitor asks for a base quantitativa auditavel after reading the public synthetic model. The owner authorized only the unit price of BRL 690; scope and acceptance remain human decisions.
routes.promised_outcome: Visitor-initiated WhatsApp conversation to define and accept one adapted unit of a base quantitativa auditavel before any charge. This is neither checkout nor an approved catalog SKU.
routes.privacy_consent: Clicking WhatsApp is visitor initiated. No message text or personal data enters web analytics; no autonomous send, checkout or nurture starts in web-cfg.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the visible unit price differs from R$ 690, if scope or SLA is invented, if checkout is enabled, or if analytics receive message text or PII.
